headline: Eiffel Tower director faces turmoil after sidelining of female staff at request of Hindu delegation
description: The exclusion of female staff members during a visit by members of an ultra-conservative Hindu religious group, sparked a strike and two investigations. Above all, the incident exposed the underlying unease within the company that runs the Iron Lady: contested management, social tensions and a lack of effective political oversight.

headline: Poll: Le Pen begins presidential campaign in strongest position ever amid worried, angry electorate
description: In France's polarized political landscape, Marine Le Pen of the far-right Rassemblement National is enjoying unprecedented support, and radical left candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon is building a strong base. Wide open for other candidates, the race is drawing significant interest from voters concerned about the future, Le Monde's first poll shows.
